### firewall-manager-nfw-policy-management-models

**Claim.** Firewall Manager Network Firewall policies manage Network Firewall firewalls for VPCs across the organization with three firewall management models: distributed (a firewall and endpoints for each account and VPC that's within policy scope), centralized (Firewall Manager creates a single Network Firewall firewall in a single Amazon VPC), or import of existing firewalls.

**Write it as.** `Firewall Manager creates and manages your firewalls`

**Scope.** Firewall Manager Network Firewall policies.

> "Firewall Manager creates and manages your firewalls based on the *firewall management type* defined by your policy."
> — [Using AWS Network Firewall policies in Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/network-firewall-policies.html)

> "You can use AWS Firewall Manager Network Firewall *policies* to manage AWS Network Firewall *firewalls* for your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud *VPCs* across your *organization* in AWS Organizations."
> — [Using AWS Network Firewall policies in Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/network-firewall-policies.html)

> "**Distributed** - For each account and VPC that's within policy scope, Firewall Manager creates a Network Firewall firewall and deploys firewall endpoints to VPC subnets, to filter network traffic."
> — [Using AWS Network Firewall policies in Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/network-firewall-policies.html)

> "**Centralized** - Firewall Manager creates a single Network Firewall firewall in a single Amazon VPC."
